digest.component_or_area: Agent tool harness - PreToolUse hook system
propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short reminder when a grep-family command (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) is invoked, using dumb string matching with no pattern classification or path heuristics.

The reminder message must be 2-3 lines, name both find_referencing_symbols as the preferred path and acknowledge the string-literal/line-number grep exceptions, and be emitted as JSON via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext with no permissionDecision field.
The hook must remain non-blocking, never exit non-zero, and never emit permissionDecision, so the grep call executes normally regardless of whether the reminder triggers.

The hook implementation must be a tracked, testable script at scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py rather than an inline JSON one-liner, and must be integrated into .claude/settings.json without overwriting story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting.

Automated tests must verify the hook fires on grep -rn foo src/ and rg foo, does not fire on non-grep commands, and asserts the emitted JSON structure against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope.
This story depends on story C (06ae-0d45-aff1-46f2) which creates .claude/settings.json and the .gitignore negation required for .claude/ to be committed.
